statement: Original motionplus-nunchuk, wiimote bound, activation re-attach compat on: all three evdev gyro axes and same-capture xwiimote MotionPlus events change between two driven values during the bounded 18-second reader run. Mapped mode 05. No A400F0=55 or A600F0=55 in the first 18 seconds after mapping; re-initialisation starts at reader close, over 18 seconds after mapping. The raw tap observes unplugged then plugged status on activation. This is a virtual software regression, not physical fidelity, rate acceptance or kernel decoded child acceptance.

applicability.revision: Original / virtual Wii Remote PID 0306; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9g bound regression with owner-confirmed temporary grants and caller synthetic calibration; no physical/radio/game/rate/challenge or child acceptance.
